evaluation: fixed 41 B scenarios x10 pairs x6 seeds; no test tuning
seed_aggregation: equal pair means, sample SD across 6 seed means
paired_gain: fine_tuned minus scratch for same seed/scenario/i/j
scenario_gain: mean of 10 paired forecast gains, separately for 6x41 scenario records and across-seed 41 scenarios
negative_transfer: scenario average gain < 0; export all cases
zero_shot_failure: compare every seed to corrected persistence; distinguish all-seed from average-only failure
fine_tuning_improvement: report mean gain and direction for every seed; original 6/6 claim requires all six positive
low_data: not established by N=33 primary; old N5/10 cannot be reused
additional_experiments: evaluate R1-2/R1-5 need only; no scaling, threshold, low-data training in this run
no_optional_stopping: complete original epochs and 6 seeds; no selected extra seeds/epochs
